description: Describe a task, pain point or desired feature in plain English or Portuguese (max 300 chars). Assembles validated catalog filters (kind, topic, transport, verified seals), runs tiered FULLTEXT retrieval and lexical/AI reranking, and returns both the structured filters and ranked MCP servers, skills or plugins. 1 free query/day per account or network, then US$ 0.01 via credit/x402 (or use GET /api/x402/smart-filter without an account). Translates natural-language prompts (English or Portuguese, max 300 chars, with pre-execution anti-prompt-injection guard and 5s burst cadence) into validated catalog filters (`kind`, `topic`, `transport`, `eco`, `origin`, `repo`, `trusted`), runs a 3-tier MySQL FULLTEXT ladder with 10-minute normalized cache, applies deterministic lexical reranking and upgrades planning/top-20 permutation-only reranking via the unified internal SDK AI service (`services/ia` via Rota Nacional) when configured. Includes 1 free personalized query per day per account or /64 network (within a 100/day product-wide free cap); further queries return HTTP 402 (US$ 0.01 via account balance, prepaid credit `cred_…`, Pix or x402 USDC on Base). For accountless pay-per-call agents, use `GET /api/x402/smart-filter`. Ordinary catalog browsing and manual filters stay free.

kind.description: Optional explicit kind lock: mcp, skill or plugin.

lang.description: Language for the filter explanation (en or pt).

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked tools to return (default 24, max 50).

query.description: Natural-language question, pain point or feature description (2 to 300 chars).

transporte.description: Optional explicit transport lock: http, sse or local.

trusted.description: True to return only verified listings with active seals.
